T008 successor002 Reviewer activation1 source-derived expectations (actor urn:a-c:T008:claude-reviewer:001). Derived only from readable UTF8 acquisitions of: reviewer-instructions, review-evaluation, GRANT, independence-policy, TASK (full), T-008 lines785-860, PRODUCT.md lines1-100, fd-support-tools.md lines1-230 (FD001..012, FD013 partial), fd-support-verification.md lines1-50,65-84 (FDV001..003, SC-AC-FD-001..015), ASSURANCE.md 680-756 (s11/s12), FOUNDATIONS.md 790-850 (Results). No candidate/HOW/code/test/fixture/proof/guide bytes acquired; review-claim.json read lines1-60 only as locator (paths/hashes, no member content).

E1 design-conservation: the HOW must place every FD001..013 operation as a tenant-owned contract consuming the caller-selected STDO3.0/RC9 method/profile, not a second lifecycle/stage sequence/task store/agent topology (PRODUCT F_D support). It must keep named domain operations (acquisition, context render, dispatch, write) distinct from F_D[v] evaluations returning judgments; keep builder basis (STDO v2.5.1-rc.2), consumer operative method and represented subject cuts distinct with no label/co-location join; and state checked fragments plus explicit unsupported cases that refuse. Falsified if the HOW lets a tool mint admission/authority, select frame/next action/frontier, infer semantic edges or unaffectedness from absent paths, or treat schema/closure/size as semantic sufficiency.

E2 implementation-conservation: code must realise the declared result algebra with exactly five core values; never raise standing (falsified->satisfied, undecidable->satisfied, not-performed->any value, unknown effect->none/completed) (FOUNDATIONS Results). Expected observable behaviours: FD001 unknown op/unsupported profile refuse with reason; FD002 dirty/untracked bytes detected without HEAD reliance; FD003 locator distinct from acquired content, missing/stale refs return gaps; FD005 no silent truncation, capacity measured only at declared boundary, unknown host context retained; FD006 preflight cannot mint admission from shape/role/ticket; FD007 request/delivery/effect/end separate, timeout/cancel preserve unknown effect, no silent rebase; FD008 raw return preserved, stale/wrong-subject/duplicate/conflicting detected, unperformed evaluations never fabricated, schema validity is not assessment; FD009 expectation recordable before candidate exposure, nonauthor direct candidate/test/source acquisition, diffs are not findings; FD010 joins only under supplied qualified operator, necessary-condition pass never full satisfaction; FD011 no rival ledger, no automatic adoption of recommendation, Reviewer/Executive mutation refused; FD012 history/frozen studies preserved, no unaffectedness inference; FD013 units/unknown counters/elapsed vs summed. ASSURANCE s11: proofs must acquire the owner-issued subject via the runnable surface, not a harness-reconstructed parallel state; where observation cannot separate subjects, indeterminate or narrower scope. Falsified by any demonstrated always-pass/always-refuse discriminator, standing raise, silent fallback/retry or rival owner semantics.

E3 guide-task-criteria (TASK 1-6): LIFECYCLE_QUICKSTART.md <=140 lines Markdown; shows Executive discover/bind/handoff to a named granted Worker and independent Reviewer acquisition; >=1 concrete full-envelope CLI/MCP reference matching actual public contracts (no invented fields, private builder, study adapter, unregistered route); distinguishes exact-byte/structural evidence, performed F_P judgment, recommendation and owner disposition; states only granted Worker/Writer mutates target, source-first expectations precede candidate bytes, caller selects next action, uncertain effects/currentness explicit; cites actual local governing/tool sources, honest unsupported/qualification bounds; no savings/quality/complete-calculus/adoption/release claim, no STDO method duplication. Falsified by any violated criterion, unsupported example field, or provenance/status claim not backed by actual acquisition; guide judgment never replaces the original Worker return (T008: historical worker consumable_closed_return=false, guide_written_late=true must remain visible).

E4 public-use-qualification (FDV001/002): only scope demonstrated by actual ordinary public Executive/Worker/Reviewer path evidence with positive and negative controls per SC-AC-FD-001..014; each unexercised operation/variant stays an explicit gap; private study/fixture success is not substitutable; prior mechanical attempt 03df642a (0 native launches) is not an assessment. FDV003/SC-015 benefit, full calculus, install/release excluded. Expect indeterminate/not_performed where evidence is absent, never upgraded by a positive technical result.

Independence expectations: nonauthor premise holds per policy only if actual producer binding shows this Reviewer authored no candidate contribution; same family/new process certifies nothing; unknown prior/external/host/managed/memory exposure and mental continuity remain unknown.

Limits/unread scope: FD013 remainder after line230, fd-support-tools tail, FDV lines51-64 content read but its acquisition ref not bound, PRODUCT after line100, INTENT.md, REFERENCE_FRAME_BASIS.md, fd-source-owner-map.md, stdo_a_c.json, all 12 RC9 method members except ASSURANCE 680-756 and FOUNDATIONS 790-850 (Conjunction of results, ACTIVATION, EVALUATION, REFERENCE_FRAME 281-440 not read), METHOD_INDEX/CLAUSE_POINTERS read lines1-40 only. Expectations are therefore partial against owner clauses and may need refinement in phase2 transparently, not silently.

mechanical_sharing.meaning: Apparatus is not semantic authority or an independence certificate; actual tool descriptions/init metadata and permitted sharing are retained
permitted: standard public CLI/MCP machinery and actual protocol/server/tool schemas explicitly classified as shared apparatus
standard test runners and source/hash/transport/evidence machinery, without author semantic findings
candidate/proof material only after actual expectation recording
protocol/ and protocol-origin.json: exact mechanically copied wire types/request schemas, not candidate algorithm or semantic findings

unknowns: external or prior exposure outside retained tool history
mental attention/independence and continuity between actual calls
